messages:
Sam: quick flag  saw a 404 when clicking the runbook TOC from /runbooks/production-deploys -> 'graceful-fallbacks' on staging. fragment seems gone.
Ravi: ugh, thanks for spotting. which exact href did you follow?
Sam: TOC entry points to /runbooks/production-deploys#graceful-fallbacks, but the heading in the doc is now 'graceful-degradation' after the wording cleanup.
Nora: that change was in PR 4150 (copy pass). we probably missed an anchor alias.
Ops-bot: docs-scan: broken fragment detected in /runbooks/production-deploys (staging). created ticket DOCS-1127.
Sam: small fix: update TOC entry to the new fragment or add an explicit anchor like <!-- anchor: graceful-fallbacks --> above the heading. happy to land a tiny patch.
Ravi: if you open a PR, tag me and Lina for review. Ops will want a short changelog entry for release notes.
Sam: opened PR: https://git.internal.redwood.io/docs/pr/8012
Sam: changes: add HTML anchor line above the heading and update TOC entry to use the new alias to be defensive. also added a unit preview test that asserts document contains the fragment. snippet I used locally:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/runbook-anchor-alias
echo "<!-- anchor: graceful-fallbacks -->" >> content/runbooks/production-deploys.md
sed -i "s/#graceful-fallbacks/#graceful-degradation/g" content/runbooks/production-deploys.md
git commit -am "docs(runbook): add anchor alias for graceful-fallbacks and update TOC"
git push origin fix/runbook-anchor-alias
```
Nora: nice. small nit: can you add a one-liner in frontmatter: changelog: "fix runbook anchor" so the docs release notes pick it up?
Sam: added changelog line and a preview test. pinging @Ravi and @Lina for review.
Ravi: quick look  LGTM, minimal change. Lina?
Lina: approved. CI flake on preview on first run, retriggered.
Ops-bot: PR 8012 passed CI and was merged by Lina. staging preview re-built.
Sam: verified on staging: TOC now resolves and the fragment lands. closing DOCS-1127. thanks all for the fast help! :party_parrot:
